SELECT b.no,b.member_id,b.CATEGORY_NO,c.CATEGORY,b.subject,b.content,b.hit,TO_CHAR(b.regdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') AS dbday FROM NOTICE_BOARD b JOIN NOTICE_CATEGORY c ON b.CATEGORY_NO=c.NO
AND (subject LIKE '%'||#{fd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%' OR content LIKE '%'||#{fd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%')
AND CATEGORY_NO=#{categoryNo}
ORDER BY no DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 20 ROWS ONLY
